points.description: Setup: labels the data as positive/negative (e.g. +1/−1) and initializes the weights (randomly or otherwise).

Loop/update: repeatedly goes over the data (epochs); for a misclassified point (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 after sign-adjusting by label, or y·<w,x> <= 0) updates w by adding eta*x (or eta*y*x); stops when weights no longer change / no misclassifications (converges since data is linearly separable). Equivalent wording and equivalent update formulations earn the marks.
